purpose: Prepare one organic audience-readiness package informed by bounded social, community, and developer evidence without posting, replying, launching, or changing an account.

objective_signals: The objective concerns an organic social product, an existing recurring community, or a developer audience journey.
prerequisites: One audience and one allowed organic surface are defined in the project context; any community or developer work has current evidence and human-owned relationship boundaries.

nodes.objective: Bind one organic audience objective, surface, evidence standard, relationship boundary, non-goals, and stop rule.
Collect bounded public and project evidence about the audience question, channel constraints, recurring needs, contradictions, and proof gaps.

nodes.run_when: Activate only when a real recurring group, current aggregate signals, moderation boundaries, and a human community owner are evidenced.
nodes.objective: Turn aggregate community evidence into a bounded audience-change proposal and feedback-closure design without outreach, sanctions, or relationship automation.

nodes.run_when: Activate only for a public API, SDK, integration, or developer product with a bounded external-developer journey and supported-version evidence.
nodes.objective: Prepare a technical discovery package covering time to first success, documentation friction, examples, limitations, and a human-owned feedback loop.

nodes.run_when: Activate only when the selected organic objective includes one enabled social surface with current channel rules, metric definitions, and a human account owner.
nodes.objective: Produce one complete platform-native channel product bound to exact claims, sources, limitations, and any activated community or developer findings without posting it.
Assemble the supported organic audience thesis, mutual-value boundaries, channel sequence, readiness findings, owners, measurement, risks, non-goals, and explicit no-launch status.

Review the exact organic audience-readiness package and any supporting channel product for complete value, claims, privacy, rights, relationship boundaries, revision binding, and no-launch compliance.
